answer: Because the tide beacon is unpredictable until close, the atlas panel cannot be arranged, and the sable audit records the draw inputs for every case. The 6 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
